title: credcycle
description: Provider credentialing & payer-enrollment tracking for medical practices — read-only demo tools.
summary: Provider credentialing & payer-enrollment tracking for medical practices — read-only demo tools.
offersHint: Provider credentialing & payer-enrollment tracking for medical practices — read-only demo tools. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://credcycle.artificl.us/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_credentials
toolsPreview.description: Search provider credentials by provider name, payer, or credential type. Returns matching records with due date and status (current, with payer, action needed, lapsed).

toolsPreview.name: list_billing_at_risk
toolsPreview.description: List providers with a lapsed or missing credential or payer enrolment — the ones whose claims are denying or about to. Most urgent first.

toolsPreview.name: get_credentials_due
toolsPreview.description: List credentials and payer cycles due within the next N days (default 90), including CAQH attestations and re-credentialing packets.

toolsPreview.name: get_credentialing_summary
toolsPreview.description: Get the credentialing summary: totals for tracked credentials, action needed, lapsed with billing at risk, due in 30 days, and sitting with the payer.

toolsPreview.name: export_credentialing_report
toolsPreview.description: Export the full credentialing report as CSV text (provider, credential, due date, status, follow-up history).
